_comment: Golden wire shape for POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/transfer after agent-console-contract-debt (C1, C2). The EXISTING record TransferRequest(string? TargetQueueId, string? TargetAgentId) at ConversationEndpoints.cs:1331 gains ONE optional member, `note` (string|null). Exactly one of targetQueueId / targetAgentId is set, as today. `note` is trimmed server-side; an omitted, null or blank note means NO note and nothing else changes; a trimmed note longer than 1000 characters is refused 400 transfer-note-too-long (fixtures/transfer-refusals.json) BEFORE any move. The 200 body is the UNCHANGED OwnershipResult (Verbara.Platform.Switchboard/OwnershipResult.cs:5), already in the agent manifest group; the Web reads none of its fields (use-conversations.ts:169 customFetch<void>). On a success its `failureReason` is null and therefore ABSENT from the JSON, not a literal null (WhenWritingNull, host design H11): `_omittedWhileNull`. With a note, the handler writes the Direction=System message of fixtures/transfer-note-message.v1.json after result.Success and before the audit write; the audit entry conversation.transferred carries the key `note` with none | written | failed (C3), never the text. Gate: the endpoint's RequireAuthorization("Permission:contacts:conversation:transfer") (ConversationEndpoints.cs:45-46) inside the /conversations group (Authenticated + operational tenant); the handler then requires the owner or a supervisor (by_supervisor audited). Every child change's delta spec must cite these field names VERBATIM (verbatim-fixture-citation rule, /xr:propagate).

toQueueWithNote.note: Customer disputes the October invoice; the amount was already corrected once, please do not re-issue it.

toAgentWithNote.note: Prefers Portuguese. Case 4471 is open on the same order.

response._unchanged: OwnershipResult, as today; shown for the queue target

sideEffects.systemMessage: ONE Message with direction System (fixtures/transfer-note-message.v1.json) when note is present; none otherwise
sideEffects.sseEvent: conversation.message with sender "System" and text = the note (fixtures/transfer-note-message.v1.json § sseEvent)

audit._rule: no free text in audit metadata: the note may carry customer data
